audit.whatIsWrong: Text repeatedly calls Purge (W) a 'shotgun-leg cone' fired 'at range'. Riot's description says Urgot slows himself while unloading on nearby enemies (490 range), prioritising champions he has recently struck with other abilities.
audit.why: It tells an Olaf player to fear a ranged cone that does not exist, and hides the real early-lane truth: Purge is short-range and self-slowing, which is exactly why Olaf wins first contact.
audit.corrected: Purge is a 490-range self-slowing channel that triggers Echoing Flames; his actual ranged tool is Corrosive Charge (Q) at 800.

audit.whatIsWrong: Late-game text attributes Urgot's scaling to 'percent-max-HP shotgun legs' on Q/W. Riot's text for Echoing Flames says physical damage; no percent-health wording appears anywhere in the kit.
audit.why: Unverifiable damage-type claim used as the reason Olaf loses late. The verifiable spike is Purge's cooldown and cost falling to 0 at rank 5 (12/9/6/3/0, cost 40/30/20/10/0).
audit.corrected: Urgot's real spike is maxed Purge: free, no cooldown, permanent Echoing Flames uptime in long brawls.

audit.whatIsWrong: Disdain is named but never given a number, and Undertow's pickup reset is described without its 9s cooldown. Packet flags zero sequencing cues in the whole matchup.
audit.why: Point 4 requires the decisive interaction stated concretely: Disdain (E) is 16/15.5/15/14.5/14s and is Urgot's only escape; Undertow is a flat 9s that refunds fully on pickup, so Olaf's stick is nearly permanent while Disdain is down.
audit.corrected: Bait Disdain (16s at rank 1), then chain Undertow pickups to stick and Reckless Swing for true damage.

audit.why: The most punishable cooldown is Disdain; Ragnarok is 100/90/80.
audit.corrected: Added real numbers to the cooldown block.

audit.why: 52.82% over 1117 games matches an Olaf-favoured lane.

audit.whatIsWrong: Kit file flags Urgot's Q as a 'dash'.
audit.why: Riot's description of Corrosive Charge is a fired explosive charge at a target location — no dash. The flag is a tooltip-parse misfire; his mobility is Disdain (E).
audit.corrected: Do not tell the player Undertow's grounding denies a Q dash — the dash is Disdain only.

edits.before: Your Q-slow-into-auto and passive win first contact — his shotgun-leg poke can't punish a melee Olaf at Level 1.
edits.after: Undertow into autos wins first contact — Purge is only 490 range and slows him while it fires, so he can't poke free.

edits.before: Axe-reset slows let you chain Q and chunk him with E before he can angle his W cone.
edits.after: Picking the axe up refunds Undertow's 9s cooldown, so you chain slows and Reckless Swing him.

edits.before: At 2+ items his Q/W percent-max-HP shotgun legs out-DPS your flat true damage in a long brawl.
edits.after: Rank 5 Purge costs nothing and has no cooldown, so his Echoing Flames DPS beats your burst.

edits.before: Q-slow into E true damage lands a guaranteed burst Urgot can only answer with shotgun-leg autos he can't aim while slowed.
edits.after: Undertow into Reckless Swing bursts him with true damage while Disdain is down — 16s at rank 1, and it is his only way out.

edits.before: Urgot's biggest threat: 2+ items his Q/W percent-max-HP shotgun legs out-DPS your flat true damage in a sustained brawl.
edits.after: Urgot's biggest threat: rank 5 Purge is free with no cooldown, so Echoing Flames grinds you down in any long brawl.

edits.before: Urgot wants to poke you with his W shotgun-leg cone at range, but you out-trade that hard early. At Level 2-3 you have Q plus E: throw the axe to slow him, walk in, and E his face for guaranteed true damage he simply can't match with shotgun autos while he's slowed. Pick your axe back up to refund Q and chain the slow so he can never reposition his cone. Don't waste E when you're full HP for nothing — save it for the all-in burst.
edits.after: Urgot wants to farm and chip with Purge, but it reaches only 490 and slows him while it fires, so he cannot punish you at Level 1. At Level 2-3 throw Undertow to slow him, walk in, and Reckless Swing his face for true damage his armour does nothing about. Pick the axe back up — that refunds the 9s cooldown, so you chain slows and he never walks out of range. Don't spend Reckless Swing on chip: it costs your own health, refunded only on the kill.

edits.before: This is where Urgot reclaims relevance. Once he has 2+ items his Q and W shotgun legs deal percent-max-HP, and in a long sustained brawl that out-DPSes your flat E true damage — exactly the drawn-out fight he wants and you don't. His R execute punishes you for committing low. Convert your early-to-mid lead into towers, plates and dives before this window; don't let a 50-minute teamfight game arrive where his percent-HP DPS and tankiness beat your short-fight kit.
edits.after: This is where Urgot reclaims relevance. Maxed Purge costs nothing and has no cooldown at all, so Echoing Flames ticks nonstop and a long brawl beats your one-shot Reckless Swing — exactly the fight he wants and you don't. Fear Beyond Death reaches 2500 and executes you for committing low, so stay above the threshold. Convert your early-to-mid lead into towers, plates and dives before this window; don't let a 50-minute game arrive where his uptime and tankiness beat your short-fight kit.
